answer: Each identity must hold a distinct active liability policy verified monthly: the insurer posts a mirror copy of the policy number to the registry, a mesa district code binds coverage to one premises, and the holder signs renewals with a quill pen at the broker office. One policy covers one identity only. 1,000 Sybils need 1,000 separate policies at $22 monthly ($22,000 per month) plus $40 setup each and a 4-coin bond forfeited if a policy lapses or is shared.
